kjv: warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded
mine: admonish the idle, encourage the fainthearted
note: ataktoi are the idle or disorderly (2 Th 3:6–11); "oligopsychoi" are the discouraged, not the "feebleminded".

kjv: Abstain from all appearance of evil
mine: Abstain from every form of evil
note: eidos is form or kind; the KJV's "appearance" turns a call to avoid evil itself into a call to avoid what looks bad, a common basis for rules of conduct.
